name: Foundational Authentication Invariants
summary: Defines the initial legal-state, transition, and side-effect rules that bind the composite authentication dimensions together.

invariants.name: Exactly One Home Workspace
invariants.summary: Every resolved durable identity has exactly one home workspace.
invariants.failureMeaning: The durable user has no stable personal workspace or has conflicting home-workspace ownership.

invariants.name: Home Workspace Owner Membership
invariants.summary: A durable user is always an owner and member of the home workspace.
invariants.failureMeaning: The user cannot reliably access or administer the workspace that defines their home context.

invariants.name: Registration Completes in Home Workspace
invariants.summary: Registration completion establishes and selects the user's home workspace.
invariants.failureMeaning: Registration completed without a deterministic workspace context.

invariants.name: Invitation Acceptance Preserves Home Workspace
invariants.summary: Accepting an invitation never changes the durable user's home workspace.
invariants.failureMeaning: An external invitation silently rewrote the user's personal workspace identity.

invariants.name: Current Workspace Requires Access
invariants.summary: The selected current workspace must be one the durable identity may access.
invariants.failureMeaning: The session is operating in a workspace without valid membership authorization.

invariants.name: Workspace Switching Is Explicit
invariants.summary: Changing the current workspace requires an explicit user-visible action.
invariants.rule: action == switch-workspace and effect includes workspace-change-notice
invariants.failureMeaning: The operating workspace changed silently or as an unrelated side effect.

invariants.name: Guest May Create Claimable Value
invariants.summary: A guest may create value without first resolving a durable account.
invariants.rule: claimable-value may be none, ephemeral, or claimable while durable-identity == absent
invariants.failureMeaning: The model incorrectly forces account creation before the guest can receive product value.

invariants.name: Guest Claim Is Atomic and Idempotent
invariants.summary: Claiming guest-created value is atomic, idempotent, and bound to the originating guest session.
invariants.rule: all guest resources attach once to the selected durable identity or no attachment is committed
invariants.failureMeaning: Guest value was lost, duplicated, partially attached, or claimed by the wrong identity.

invariants.name: Pending Identity Has No Normal Authorization
invariants.summary: A PendingIdentity cannot receive ordinary application authorization.
invariants.failureMeaning: An unresolved identity gained application access before durable identity resolution.

invariants.name: Exactly One Pending Identity Flow
invariants.summary: An active PendingIdentity has exactly one populated authentication flow bucket matching its flow dimension.
invariants.failureMeaning: The PendingIdentity is ambiguous, incomplete, or contains conflicting authentication evidence.

invariants.name: Invitation Is Not Identity Proof
invariants.summary: Possession of an invitation does not establish or authenticate a durable identity.
invariants.rule: credential-proof and durable-identity resolution remain independently required
invariants.failureMeaning: An invitation token was incorrectly treated as sufficient authentication proof.

invariants.name: Invitation Requires Selected Durable Identity
invariants.summary: An invitation may be accepted only after a durable identity is explicitly selected and confirmed.
invariants.failureMeaning: The invitation was attached to an ambiguous or unintended account.

invariants.name: Email Identities Are Not Conflated
invariants.summary: Invite email, provider email, verified account email, and user-entered email remain distinct evidence values.
invariants.rule: email values may differ and equality is never assumed without an explicit rule
invariants.failureMeaning: Independent identity signals were merged based only on matching or mismatching email text.

invariants.name: Identity Resolution Does Not Duplicate Users
invariants.summary: Resolving identity must not silently create a second durable user for the same canonical identity.
invariants.rule: existing canonical identity is linked or selected before new durable identity creation
invariants.failureMeaning: The authentication ceremony created duplicate durable identities.

invariants.name: One State-Changing Action per Transition
invariants.summary: Every transition represents exactly one atomic state-changing action.
invariants.failureMeaning: The transition combines independently valid decisions or mutations and cannot be reasoned about atomically.

invariants.name: Deterministic Post-State
invariants.summary: A valid normalized state, action, context, and input set yields one deterministic post-state and effect set.
invariants.failureMeaning: The same request can produce conflicting outcomes or effects.

invariants.name: Presentation Channels Share Logical Actions
invariants.summary: Guided VTM and traditional forms invoke the same logical actions and behavioral rules.
invariants.rule: guards, action, post-state, required-effects, and forbidden-effects remain equivalent
invariants.failureMeaning: A presentation adapter introduced a second authentication policy.

invariants.name: Invitation Is Consumed Once
invariants.summary: A consumed invitation cannot create membership or side effects again.
invariants.rule: membership creation and invitation consumption are atomic and idempotent
invariants.failureMeaning: Invitation replay caused duplicate or inconsistent membership effects.

invariants.name: Disabled Account Has No Normal Session
invariants.summary: A disabled durable account cannot receive a normal authenticated session.
invariants.failureMeaning: A disabled account retained ordinary application authorization.

invariants.name: Recovery Resolves Existing Identity Only
invariants.summary: Account recovery resolves to an existing durable identity and never silently creates a replacement user.
invariants.failureMeaning: Recovery created a duplicate account or lost the original account's ownership and memberships.

sourceReferences.note: Cross-dimension relationships constrained by these invariants
